description: This file defines an abstract class 'BlockTransferMessage' and its nested enum 'Type', along with a static decoder class for deserializing messages based on type. It is part of Spark's network shuffle protocol, handling message types for block transfer operations such as open, upload, fetch, and remove blocks.

classes.name: BlockTransferMessage
classes.description: An abstract class representing network messages for block transfer in Spark shuffle protocol.

classes.name: BlockTransferMessage.Type
classes.description: Enumeration of message types with associated byte IDs for serialization.

classes.name: BlockTransferMessage.Decoder
classes.description: Static class providing deserialization of messages from ByteBuffer based on message type.

methods.name: type
methods.description: Abstract method to get the message type.

methods.name: toByteBuffer
methods.description: Serializes the message into a ByteBuffer, including its type.
